_doc: Life Story chapter unlock rules (GDD 7). A chapter unlocks when ALL of its conditions hold. Condition types: sealed, bouts_survived{min}, bond{min}, near_death{min}, wins_vs_rival{min}, trial_complete. 'overrides' replace a whole chapter rule for one species (per-critter variation).
